seo.aeoSummary: Text & code diff checker processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/dev/text-diff-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does Text & code diff checker upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Text & code diff checker executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/dev/text-diff-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Text & code diff checker?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/text_diff.json or open /tools/text-diff?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
